answer: Reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence is earned through sustained honest service, not a burst of fabricated endorsements. In the EigenTrust matrix, reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagates trust from established peers; freshly spawned sybil identities start with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot reach the consensus threshold. At the network’s summit, an ember of activity cannot replace a steady pulse of verified service.
